ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) regions comprising approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark-gray contiguous field across 90%+ of the fluke surface. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe displays a truncated, irregular convexity ending in an eroded terminal edge. Right lobe displays a smooth, parabolic convex sweep tapering to a pointed tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized to the mid-to-lower ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular erosion/tissue loss along the entirety of the left lobe's trailing edge; distinct vertical depigmented band on the medial right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Marked bilateral asymmetry where the left lobe exhibits significantly higher topological complexity and degradation compared to the right lobe.
